title: Plumbing Fundamentals
shortDescription: Understand water systems, useful plumbing tools and everyday leak prevention.
description: Learn the parts of a basic household water system, how to choose common hand tools and how to inspect simple leaks. Lessons emphasize safe shutoff, tidy work and knowing when a repair needs a trained plumber.
objectives: Recognize common household pipes and fittings
Select basic tools for inspection and maintenance
Locate shutoff valves and reduce water damage
Describe common leak symptoms and safe next steps

modules.title: How household plumbing works
modules.summary: Get familiar with water supply, drainage and common fittings.

lessons.title: Following the water path
lessons.description: Trace how water reaches a home and how used water leaves through the drainage system.

lessons.title: Pipes, joints and fittings
lessons.description: Recognize common pipe materials, connectors, taps and household fixtures.

modules.title: Tools and safe preparation
modules.summary: Prepare a work area and use basic plumbing tools carefully.

lessons.title: Essential plumbing hand tools
lessons.description: Learn the purpose of adjustable wrenches, pipe grips, tape measures and pliers.

lessons.title: Find and use a water shutoff valve
lessons.description: Locate common shutoff points and reduce water flow before inspection or maintenance.

modules.title: Leak checks and maintenance
modules.summary: Spot early signs of leaks and decide what needs professional repair.

lessons.title: Finding signs of a leak
lessons.description: Check for damp patches, dripping joints, unusual water sounds and changes in water pressure.

lessons.title: Preventing damage and escalating repairs
lessons.description: Protect the work area, record what you find and know when a plumber should take over.
